bash: cd my_website; python3 - <<'EOF'
import re,html
# Structural sanity: balanced tags on every generated page.
VOID={'meta','link','br','hr','img','input','area','base','col','embed','source','track','wbr'}
import glob,os
bad=0
for p in glob.glob('public/**/*.html',recursive=True):
    s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
    stack=[]
    for m in re.finditer(r'<(/?)([a-zA-Z0-9]+)([^>]*?)(/?)>',s):
        close,tag,attrs,selfc=m.group(1),m.group(2).lower(),m.group(3),m.group(4)
        if tag in VOID or selfc=='/' or tag=='!doctype': continue
        if close: 
            if not stack or stack[-1]!=tag:
                print(f'{p}: mismatched </{tag}>, open={stack[-3:]}'); bad+=1; break
            stack.pop()
        else: stack.append(tag)
    if stack: print(f'{p}: unclosed {stack}'); bad+=1
print('unbalanced pages:',bad)
# heading order
for p in sorted(glob.glob('public/**/*.html',recursive=True)):
    s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
    hs=[int(h) for h in re.findall(r'<h([1-4])[ >]',s)]
    print(os.path.basename(p).ljust(58), 'headings:', hs[:12])
EOF
